'''2014 MPC Holotable Stephen Cellucci DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Cellucci]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Holotable).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Holotable
